title: Resiliency Stewardship: Initiative Catalog & Ownership Contracts
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a canonical Initiative Catalog and standardized Ownership Contracts for all reliability and SLO-related initiatives. The catalog is a machine-readable ledger that maps each initiative to: SLI definitions, SLO targets, error budget allocation, primary/secondary owners with rotation rules, rollout gating criteria (canary thresholds, rollback triggers), and linked runbooks/dashboards. The goal is to reduce coordination overhead during incidents and rollouts, enable automated gating in the Console, and make error-budget-driven prioritization explicit across teams.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Initiative Catalog schema defined and approved by Reliability and Platform PMs; 2) Ownership Contract template (human + machine fields) published in Confluence; 3) 10 pilot initiatives onboarded and visible in the Console with links to dashboards and runbooks; 4) Automated gating rules prototyped for one canary flow that triggers rollback when error_budget_burn_rate > 2.0 for 10m and SLI breaches > 0.5% in 5m; 5) Handoff/rotation policy documented and sign-offs from legal/security if needed.

decisions:
- Use canonical JSON-LD schema for initiatives to support both human-readability and programmatic ingestion.
- Error budget burn rate metric standardized to 5m and 1h windows for alerts and gating.
- Owners must designate both a primary and a rotating secondary with a maximum rotation cycle of 8 weeks.
- Gating defaults: conservative rollback thresholds; teams may tune per initiative with explicit approvals.

risks: 1) Adoption risk: teams may resist moving from spreadsheets to the catalog without lightweight importers. 2) Automation safety: incorrectly tuned gating could cause customer-facing rollbacks. 3) Data mapping: inconsistent SLI definitions across services may reduce catalog value.
